functions.summary: Binary searches a sorted string table (16-byte entries). this+4 holds the entry count, this+8 the table base; each entry stores a key pointer at +0 and a value pointer at +8. Compare the search key a2 against the entry key with strcmp. On equality break out of the loop; if the key is greater move the low bound to mid+1, otherwise move the high bound to mid.
If the low bound reaches the high bound without a match, copy the input key a2 into the output buffer a3 and return -1.
On match, load the value pointer at the matched entry (table + 16*mid + 8); if null substitute the default string byte_5EA438.
